selected_primary_idea.title: DimensionBridge: A Cross-Scale Falsifiability Atlas for Extra-Dimension Models
selected_primary_idea.summary: A design-only model-to-observable registry and joint decision framework that reports bounded model status rather than a universal number of dimensions.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Explicit translation contracts, cross-channel parameter-overlap maps, alternative-explanation tests, and observational-identifiability audits prevent over-interpretation of both null results and anomalies.
falsification_conditions: Incorrect exclusion outside the channels' declared parameter coverage.
An anomaly is attributed uniquely without alternative-model comparison.
Independent reviewers cannot reproduce status reason codes.

rejected_ideas.reason: A model-independent numerical count of hidden dimensions has no direct observable definition.
A single-channel discovery claim violates the Survey alternative-explanation invariant.
